default_change_policy: Retain multi-small. This small controlled corpus cannot establish a new universal default. Optional profiles must be explicit, never confidence-selected.
metrics: NFC and whitespace normalized, case/punctuation/accents retained. CER/WER and exactness; no output repair. Failed conversions score as empty; external scans unscored. Separate tiers and languages.
resources: Two full-process repetitions per case/profile; rotate profile order. Sample aggregate CLI+registered direct OCR process RSS every 10ms, two GiB polling guard, 90s timeout. Includes benchmark-only PID-registration Python wrapper startup. No system process enumeration. No cold-host or steady-state inference claim.
functional_preflight: Before timing, convert the existing English prose fixture once per profile and require an OCR result without backend errors. No accuracy tuning or model substitution.
